title: 🛂 SPN-158 Wait for writable admission after restore
body:
After restore commit, session GET can report signed-out while maintenance still pauses authentication writes. This fixture now waits for application-observed running admission and the original session401 within its existing 20-second budget, then makes the unchanged authentication and acknowledged-write attempt.

## 🧪 Implementation and local evidence

The shared probe requires session401, maintenance200, supervised availability and running phase. One shared abort signal bounds both readiness reads inside the existing20 seconds; finally clears the timer and aborts a pending read. Ordinary60-second client requests remain unchanged. Error output is limited to fixed stages/statuses/allowlisted phases and the original assertion cause.

The deterministic HTTP fixture holds paused admission: maintenance200/session401 coexist with auth503 and unchanged session/challenge rows. Running then permits options and expected writes. A held-response control proves shared cancellation closes the pending read/socket with exactly two reads. The actual old-predicate mutation failed this shared paused control; its exact restoration and original resource-aborted attempts remain retained. No mutation repeat, gate weakening, authentication retry or broad local matrix was added.

Current integrated runtime checks used `0e32180a77a22466e6bfaa9f4c2a1b6a5769a139`; final source adds maintained documentation/evidence only. Exact source hashes and contexts distinguish the pre-commit index generation and final ticket/index validation.
